WITH rc AS (SELECT e.EmployeeId, e.City, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Customer c JOIN Employee e ON e.EmployeeId = c.SupportRepId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId, e.City),
ca AS (SELECT City, AVG(cnt * 1.0) AS avg_cnt FROM rc GROUP BY City),
k AS (SELECT rc.City, rc.EmployeeId, rc.cnt, ca.avg_cnt FROM rc JOIN ca ON rc.City = ca.City WHERE rc.cnt > ca.avg_cnt),
tot AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) * 1.0 AS t FROM k)
SELECT k.City, SUM(k.cnt) AS total_customers, AVG(k.cnt - k.avg_cnt) AS avg_excess, AVG(k.cnt / tot.t) AS avg_share
FROM k, tot GROUP BY k.City
